|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai-2021-02-18.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-greenleaderingreensq91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “A-wing Cannon”. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of any starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2021<ref name="img-greenleaderingreensq3f533fb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC replaced its high-resolution PNG upload of the day before with the GIF made from it for Holotable (the PNG was moved to the “hires” folder); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (703×980 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “A-wing Cannon”. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of any starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 15 January 2022<ref name="img-greenleaderingreensq793bf65">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
